about_the_game:
WARNING!

This game (with the exception of the Main Menu, the UI, and the pinging ability) contains complete silence and loud jumpscares!

Warrens Of Random

Warrens Of Random is a first-person, minimalistic horror game where you must escape 20 mazes that vary in difficulty.

Random Spawns

Every time you exit a maze, there's a chance that you'll spawn in a random maze and must survive the previous or future maze twice, so even though you'll survive more than 20 times, you must survive in order, from Maze 1 to Maze 20.

Challenge Yourself

The default mode is Normal mode, so if you want a challenge, go ahead and try Hardcore mode or Speedrunner mode:

  • In Normal mode, you have 3 lives, the ability to save your game, and can ping the exit every 5 minutes. This is so you can familiarize yourself with the mazes.

  • In Hardcore mode, you have 1 life, the ability to save your game, a higher chance of random spawns, and the exit also spawns in random locations when a random spawn happens. You also cannot ping the exit.

  • In Speedrunner mode, you have 1 life, no saves, and no random spawns, just finish the game as fast as you can.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
